subject: Regional latency surge impacting NimbleHealth — executive update
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: nimble-support@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: High error rate / latency in US-west region

Hi Grace —

Starting ~08:50 PT we are seeing a sharp increase in 500 responses from the Redwood generation endpoint for our production workspace (nimble-prod). Latency jumps to 6-12s and a subset of requests are failing entirely. This is impacting our triage and appointment creation flows.

Attached a small sample of logs and request ids (nimble_error_log_0118.zip). We have a support channel open (nimble-support@nimblehealth.com) but wanted to escalate since this is affecting patient-facing flows.

Can you confirm if this is a platform-wide issue or scoped to our workspace/region? ETA for resolution would be super helpful.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Integrations, NimbleHealth

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: High error rate / latency in US-west region — initiating incident bridge

Team —

FYI, NimbleHealth reporting production 5xx + latency in US-west, started 08:50 PT. Customer sample logs attached. I'm initiating an incident bridge and tagging PD-4512. Please join the bridge now (link in PD ticket).

Immediate asks:
- Marcus: please validate whether this is a regional provisioning/GPU scheduling issue or model-specific degradation.
- Stephanie: coordinate customer comms and legal/security if needed.
- Mateo: prepare canary fallback (lower-capacity model / different region) we can shift traffic to if necessary.
- Sean: if we need executive-level outreach (credits / SLA), standby—I'll draft update for Elaine.

I'll update the customer with an initial acknowledgement and ETA within 30 minutes.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: nimble_error_log_0118.zip

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: High error rate / latency in US-west region — initial findings

Grace / team,

Bridge notes (initial):
- PagerDuty PD-4512 opened at 08:52 PT.
- Symptoms: elevated 95/99th latency, increased tail queuing, and intermittent 5xx from GPU hosts in us-west2.
- Root-candidate: autoscaling/eviction of some GPU instances due to a rolling maintenance job that overlapped with a burst in allocation requests; kernel-level memory fragmentation observed on 3 hosts.
- Impact: ~27% error rate for nimble-prod across 3 availability zones; other customers in us-west see degraded p95 as well. Scope is regional (us-west).

Mitigations in flight:
1) Remove scheduled maintenance window and pause any automatic evictions (in progress). Estimated immediate improvement in 8-12 minutes after hosts rejoin.
2) Rolling re-provision of 5 impacted hosts with priority for low-latency sku.
3) Traffic steering: engineering to open region fallback to us-east for high-priority traffic; Mateo to execute canary.

I'll update with a targeted ETA for service stabilization in 20 minutes.

-Marcus
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: nimble-support@nimblehealth.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High error rate / latency in US-west region — executive update and next steps

Hi Elaine —

Thank you for the report and for the sample logs. We have an active incident (PD-4512) and our engineering team has identified the issue as a regional provisioning/interruption affecting GPU hosts in our us-west cluster. Key points:  

- Impact: NimbleHealth (nimble-prod) is experiencing elevated latency and intermittent 5xx; approximate affected traffic ~25-30% during the peak window.
- Scope: Regional (us-west). We are not seeing evidence of data exposure; this is an infrastructure availability issue.
- What we're doing now: pausing scheduled maintenance, reprovisioning impacted hosts, and steering high-priority traffic to us-east as a temporary fallback. Marcus expects measurable improvement within ~15 minutes and service stabilization in ~30–40 minutes.
- What you can expect from us: we will provide a post-incident report with timeline, root cause analysis, and mitigations within 48 hours. I will also include the draft executive summary for your legal/compliance review.

As an acknowledgement of the customer impact, once the incident is resolved we will proactively apply a one-month service credit to your account and open a joint postmortem review session to go through the mitigation plan. If you prefer a different remediation (e.g., extended retention of logs or increased support hours), let us know and we can tailor it.

If you need any immediate temporary workarounds, Stephanie is copied and can coordinate a dedicated support channel or engineer-on-call.

I'll follow up with another update at 10:20 PT or sooner if we have a full-service restore.

Sincerely,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: executive_update_0118.pdf

From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: nimble-support@nimblehealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High error rate / latency in US-west region — thanks

Grace —

Thanks for the prompt engagement and the clear update. We see traffic normalizing on our end after 10:05 PT; still monitoring but much improved. We appreciate the proposed credit and the offer of a joint postmortem — please include our platform lead (cc'ed in support thread) on that session.

Please share the postmortem draft and timeline link when available.

Best,
Elaine
